nodes.label: Optimized for Speed
nodes.rationale: Retrieves only 3 chunks instead of 5 for 40% less context overhead, caps GPT-4o generation at 150 max tokens, and uses temperature 0.3 to keep answers fast, focused, and non-rambling; session isolation also avoids cross-user context bloat.

nodes.label: Semantic Chunking
nodes.rationale: Targets 500 tokens (~2000 chars) per chunk with a 50-token overlap between chunks to prevent context loss at boundaries, and breaks at natural sentence/paragraph boundaries rather than arbitrary cut points; also strips null bytes and special characters.

nodes.label: Vector Search with pgvector
nodes.rationale: Uses PostgreSQL's pgvector extension with HNSW indexing to perform fast approximate nearest neighbor search (cosine distance) over embeddings, trading exactness for speed so queries stay in the 3-5 second range.
